'''Darth Vitus''' was an individual who became a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]<ref name="Behind the Threat" /> at some point before the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Mandalorian Wars]] and the [[Jedi Civil War]],<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide">"Behind the Threat: The Sith (Part 5): Antiheroes" states that Vitus lived at some point before the "Knights of the Old Republic Era". According to the ''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]'', the Mandalorian Wars and the Jedi Civil War were two major events of the era in which the ''Knights of the Old Republic'' metaseries is set, so therefore Vitus must have lived somewhen before the outbreak of both those conflicts.</ref> at which point he was considered an ancient Sith. After gaining significant knowledge of how to utilize [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]], he desired to develop his understanding of the subject further, so he carried out research at a [[Darth Vitus's compound|compound]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Oricon]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. During the course of his investigations, Vitus experimented on monsters that were strong in the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].<ref name="Behind the Threat" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vitus was first mentioned in "[[Behind the Threat: The Sith]] (Part 5): Antiheroes," an article that was released by [[Wizards of the Coast]] published on [[Wizards.com]] and written by [[Matthew Grau]].<ref name="Behind the Threat" /> ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[BioWare]] and [[Broadsword Online Games]], included game files for a character of the same name; however the files were unused.<ref name="Jedipedia">{{WebCite|url=https://swtor.jedipedia.net/en/npc/vitus|text=Darth Vilus &ndash; NPCs|archivedate=20200503051653}}</ref>
